Etymology: [老] (elder, top — simplified) + 日 (sun/say, bottom) — an elder who speaks with authority; a person defined by their role or expertise.
[木] (tree, left) + [目] (eye, right) — an eye looking carefully into a tree; mutual inspection and regard between two parties.
[人] (person, left) + 系 (lineage/connection, right) — a person tied into a system of connections; one who is in charge of or related to something.
[禾] (grain, left) + [刀] (knife, right) — a knife harvesting grain efficiently; the benefit and advantage of a sharp, effective tool.
[己] (self, left) + [攴] (strike/tap, right) — striking oneself to correct one's own course; to reform or change.
[求] Originally a pictograph of a fur garment — fur was a prized commodity actively sought after; the meaning of seeking and requesting developed from that pursuit.
[大] (person with arms out, below) + 乙 (a slipping mark, top) — something slipping out of a person's grasp; to lose or let go.
[石] (stone, left) + 隺 (a bird alighting firmly, right) — a bird landing solidly on stone; firm and certain like stone underfoot.
[王] (king/jewel, left) + [見] (see, right) — the jewel becoming visible; to appear or manifest in the present moment.
[宀] (roof, top) + 貫 (pierce through/fill completely, below) — something solid filling a space completely under a roof; fruit, fullness, and by extension truth or reality.
[予] Originally a pictograph of a shuttle being pushed ahead through a loom — preparing and passing through in advance; beforehand or in advance.
[宀] (roof, top) + 正 (correct/straight, below) — correctness established and settled under a roof; a decided, fixed matter.
[頁] (head/page, right) + 是 (this/correct, left) — the correct heading at the forefront; a topic or title.
[門] (gate, outer) + [口] (mouth, inner) — a mouth calling out at a gate seeking entry; to ask or inquire.
[竹] (bamboo, top) + 合 (combine/fit, below) — bamboo writing slips fitted together; the ancient tablets on which answers were recorded, hence a response.
[言] (speech, left) + 兑 (exchange/open up, right) — speech that opens something up for another; to explain or expound.
[言] (speech, left) + 己 (self, right) — one's own speech set down permanently; to record or write.
[言] (speech, left) + 炎 (flames, right) — speech that blazes and rises between people like fire; to converse or discuss.
[土] (earth) + 幸 (lucky/bound hands) + [攴] (strike, right) — a bound person receiving judgment; the idea of returning news or requiting something, hence to report.
[牛] (ox, top) + [口] (mouth, bottom) — an ox at the mouth of an altar; the announcement of a ritual offering, hence to tell or declare.
[言] (speech, left) + 周 (all around/circuit, right) — speech that goes all the way around a subject; to investigate thoroughly or tune precisely.
[王] (king/jade, left) + 里 (village/ordered land, right) — the ordered veins of jade being worked; the natural patterns or principles within things, hence reason or logic.
[生] (life/birth, bottom) + 产 (cliff with things emerging, top) — life emerging from a high place; to give birth or produce.
[木] (wood, bottom) + 業 (a rack of musical bells on a stand, top) — a large wooden framework holding instruments; the effort and craft of an undertaking, hence business or work.
[人] (person, left) + 動 (move, right) — a person in constant movement; to work or labour.
[彳] (step/movement, left) + 殳 (a hand wielding a tool, right) — a person moving with a tool in hand fulfilling a task; a duty or role.
[正] (correct/straight, left) + [攴] (strike/enforce, right) — enforcing correctness with authority; the administration of government affairs.
[广] (building/lean-to, top) + 付 (hand over/give, bottom) — a building where things are officially handed over and administered; a government office.
[言] (speech, left) + 義 (righteousness/correct measure, right) — speech measured against what is right and correct; formal deliberation or discussion.
[口] (mouth/opening, top) + 貝 (shell/money, bottom) — a valued person at the opening of an organisation, counted like a coin; a member.
[貝] (shell/money, bottom) + 弗 (not/dispersing, top) — money dispersing and going away; an expense or cost.
[禾] (grain, left) + 兑 (exchange/hand over, right) — grain handed over as payment; the portion of harvest surrendered as tax.
[金] (metal, left) + 艮 (firm/stopping, right) — a firm, enduring metal; silver, which holds its value steadily.
[金] (metal, left) + 失 (lose, right — used phonetically) — the metal that loses its shine; iron, which rusts unlike gold or silver.
[曲] (bent/field furrows, top) + 辰 (a hand tool for tilling, bottom) — a tilling tool working bent furrows in a field; agriculture.
[工] A pictograph of a carpenter's square or a tool with a handle — the instrument of craftsmanship; construction or craft.
[匚] (box/container, outer) + 矢 (arrow, inner) + 殳 (hand with tool) — a container of healing arrows or instruments; the tools of medicine, hence a doctor or medicine.
[艸] (plant, top) + 楽 (music/pleasure, bottom) — a plant that brings pleasure and relief; a medicinal herb or remedy.
[疒] (sickness radical — a person lying in bed, top-left) + 丙 (third/fire, bottom-right) — a feverish person confined to bed; illness.
[阜] (mound/enclosed grounds, left) + 完 (complete/enclosed, right) — a complete enclosed compound; an institution or enclosed establishment.
[禾] (grain, left) + 斗 (measuring scoop, right) — measuring and classifying grain; the sorting and classification of knowledge into departments.
[石] (stone, left) + 开 (open/grind apart, right) — grinding and opening up stone; to polish or refine through study.
[穴] (cave/hole, top) + 九 (nine/elbow reaching deep, bottom) — reaching deep to the end of a cave; to investigate to the very limit.
[言] (speech, left) + 式 (ceremony/method, right) — speech used in a formal method; a test or examination.
[馬] (horse, left) + 佥 (all/many people, right) — testing a horse before many witnesses; proving through trial, hence a test or result.
[竹] (bamboo, top) + 弟 (younger brother/order, bottom) — bamboo slips arranged in sequence like younger siblings in order; an ordinal prefix indicating rank or sequence.
[广] (building, top) + 廿 (twenty/a mat) + 巾 (cloth, bottom) — a cloth mat laid out in a building; a seat or one's place at a gathering.
[言] (speech, left) + 果 (result/fruit, right) — speech that produces a result; a lesson, section, or assigned task.
[宀] (roof, top) + 百 (hundred people, bottom) — a hundred people sheltered under one roof; a lodging place.
[囗] (enclosure/border, outer) + 鄙 components (settled area, inner) — a bordered representation of a settled area; a diagram or map.
[矢] (arrow, left) + [口] (mouth, right) — words as swift and sure as an arrow; to know and inform with certainty.
[人] (person, left) + 云 (clouds moving/speak, right) — a person carrying words like clouds moving across the sky; to transmit or convey.
[走] (run, left) + 己 (self/coil, right) — the self uncoiling and springing into motion; to rise, wake up, or occur.
[冎] (bones/divide, left) + [刀] (knife, right) — a knife separating bones cleanly; to divide or part.
[口] (mouth/opening, bottom) + 亼 (a lid fitting over, top) — a lid fitting perfectly over an opening; to fit together or meet.
[角] (horn, left) + 刀 (knife, middle) + 牛 (ox, right) — a knife separating an ox's horn from its body; to unravel or solve.
[頁] (head/page, right) + 原 (origin/source, left) — bowing one's head back to the source; a heartfelt request or wish.
[女] (woman, left) + 台 (platform/foundation, right) — a woman at the founding platform; to begin or start.
[糸] (thread, left) + 冬 (winter, right) — a thread reaching its winter end; the final point of something, to finish.
[糸] (thread, left) + 売 (sell/pass on, right) — a thread being passed on without breaking; to continue or keep going.
[比] Two identical figures placed side by side — direct pictograph of two people or things set next to each other for comparison.
[頁] (head/page, right) + 米 (rice, middle) + 大 (large) — grains sorted and headed into categories; a kind or type.
[禾] (grain, left) + 重 (heavy/layered, right) — heavy layered grain; a seed that contains within it the full weight of the next generation, hence seed or kind.
[阜] (mound/boundary wall, left) + 祭 (festival/ritual, right) — a ritual held at the boundary wall; the edge or occasion where things meet.
[糸] (thread, left) + 勺 (a ladle/small measure, right) — a thread measured out to a small, approximate amount; approximately or a binding promise.
[車] (wheel/cart, left) + 専 (concentrated/spin, right) — a wheel spinning in concentrated rotation; to turn over or roll.
[月] (moon, bottom-left) + 亡 (absent/distant, top) + 王 (king, bottom-right) — a king gazing at the distant moon; looking toward something far away with longing, hence hope.
